decisionLogic: Insert the evidence point after the route segment that minimizes d(A,P)+d(P,B)-d(A,B), using great-circle distances. Preserve the original route and require explicit user selection before applying the candidate.
uncertainty: Route optimization concerns horizontal geometry only and does not repair CRS, vertical datum, lithology, correlation or review deficiencies.
exclusions: No shortest-path optimization against terrain/access constraints
validationMethod: Minimum-segment, immutability, eligibility, invalid-input, topology and GUI-backend tests
reopenCondition: Multiple-waypoint optimization, terrain/access constraints, projected-CRS engineering distances, or eligible real evidence is required
